Name: Bundles Anywhere
Author: GSNEL
Description:
[b]Description[/b]

Open the Junimo Note from the in-game menu (ESC) and turn in bundle items from anywhere on the map: the mines, the beach, your bed at 1:50am. No more running back to the Community Center to drop off a single Salmonberry.

[b]Main Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Hand in bundle items from the Junimo Note tab in the ESC menu, anywhere in Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Full multiplayer support. Anyone on the farm can deposit, and area completions stay in sync.[/*]
[*]Works on existing saves. Areas you already finished are recognized when you load the game.[/*]
[*]Automatically disabled if you joined Joja.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Works in single-player.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer for both host and farmhands.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher.[/*]
[/list]
